_comment: Dead code kept on purpose. Every entry states why. Anything not listed fails the build; anything listed that is no longer dead also fails, so this file cannot rot quietly. See scripts/check-dead-code.mjs.

backendModules.apps/backend/src/weir/api/main.py: ASGI entrypoint. Referenced by string as weir.api.main:app from docker/entrypoint.sh, scripts/dev-backend.ps1 and the E2E conftest, never by import.
backendModules.apps/backend/src/weir/core/exceptions.py: Declared scaffolding for domain error types. Kept as the agreed home for them rather than re-litigated here.
backendModules.apps/backend/src/weir/platform/settings/: Phase 4 placeholder; the module docstring records that no table is introduced yet.
Deliberately not mounted, so the API does not imply a finished Settings surface.
